Docket 1.3.103

**Docket is free to try: run a full audit of any site without a key and see your score, how many problems each area has, and the most important problem in full with its fix. [Buy it once](https://kerr-affiliate-hub.kerrco.workers.dev/buy/docket?src=release-notes), $349, or 4 payments of $87.25, to see all the others, the ranked fix plan and the markup to paste. 30-day refund, no conditions.**

- *The same service in two towns.* A business with a page per location was told
  its location pages competed for one search. Pages that name different places
  are now two searches, and a contact page no longer counts as competing with a
  service page.
- *Reviews of your own business.* Docket said marking up the reviews a business
  shows about itself would put stars in search results. Google does not show
  stars for those, so Docket now asks only for rating markup on pages about a
  product, recipe, event or similar.
- *Places of worship.* A church, mosque or synagogue was told to add
  LocalBusiness markup and that it had no customer reviews. It is now told to
  use its own type (Church, Mosque, Synagogue), and the customer-review advice
  is for businesses only.

99 checks across 13 areas.
